description: This file defines the 'Element' class in the Drupal editor module, responsible for rendering and processing text editor elements, including handling pre-render callbacks, attaching libraries, and ensuring XSS safety.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: A service class for handling text editor render elements, implementing TrustedCallbackInterface for pre-render processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Element class with a plugin manager service.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns an array of trusted callback method names, specifically 'preRenderTextFormat'.

methods.name: preRenderTextFormat
methods.description: Pre-render callback that configures the text format element, attaches libraries, filters content for XSS, and manages editor settings.
